key: CAIN: Heyy~
en: CAIN: Heyy~
ja: カイン: やっほ~

key: Found Charlotte, but I'm a little busy right now.
en: Found Charlotte, but I'm a little busy right now.
ja: シャルロットは見つけたんだけど、オレ、今ちょっと手が離せなくて。

key: Wanna take care of her?
en: Wanna take care of her?
ja: 代わりに面倒見てくれる?

key: CAIN: Cut me some slack; I've been going two on one this whole time!
en: CAIN: Cut me some slack; I've been going two on one this whole time!
ja: カイン: 勘弁してよ、オレずっと二対一でやってたんだよ!

key: I mean, I can be into that, but not like this.
en: I mean, I can be into that, but not like this.
ja: まあ、そういうのも嫌いじゃないけど、こういう形はちょっとねぇ。

key: Nidoking is focused on the battle!
en: Nidoking is focused on the battle!
ja: ニドキングは戦いに集中している!

key: Why'd you set me free?
en: Why'd you set me free?
ja: なんでぼくを外に出したの?

key: I'm a bad kid. I'm not supposed to be allowed out.
en: I'm a bad kid. I'm not supposed to be allowed out.
ja: ぼくは悪い子だから。外に出しちゃいけないんだ。

key: SHELLY: Um... Oops?
en: SHELLY: Um... Oops?
ja: シェリー: え、えっと……あちゃー?

key: I'm a bad kid, I'm a bad kid, Doctor always says I'm a bad kid...
en: I'm a bad kid, I'm a bad kid, Doctor always says I'm a bad kid...
ja: ぼくは悪い子、悪い子、博士がいつもそう言うんだ……

key: SHELLY: Um... I'm not exactly a professional or anything, but the Doctor seems like kind of a--
en: SHELLY: Um... I'm not exactly a professional or anything, but the Doctor seems like kind of a--
ja: シェリー: あの……わ、私、専門家とかじゃないけど、あの博士って、なんていうか……

key: Well, a jerk.
en: Well, a jerk.
ja: まあ、いやなやつ。

key: So... maybe you don't have to listen to him?
en: So... maybe you don't have to listen to him?
ja: だから……博士の言うこと、聞かなくてもいいんじゃないかな?

key: I mean... do YOU think you're a bad kid?
en: I mean... do YOU think you're a bad kid?
ja: それに……あなた自身は、自分のこと悪い子だと思う?

key: CHILD: Everyone says I am.
en: CHILD: Everyone says I am.
ja: こども: みんながそう言うから。

key: And I'm here in the Circuit...
en: And I'm here in the Circuit...
ja: それに、ぼくはここ、サーキットにいるし……

key: So I must be, right?
en: So I must be, right?
ja: だから、きっとそうなんだよね?

key: SHELLY: Ummm... I dunno.
en: SHELLY: Ummm... I dunno.
ja: シェリー: う、うーん……わからないな。

key: In a lot of books I've read, bad guys lie to the heroes just to discourage them.
en: In a lot of books I've read, bad guys lie to the heroes just to discourage them.
ja: 私が読んだ本だと、悪者ってヒーローをくじけさせるために、よくうそをつくんだよ。

key: And if it's like that, it's important to stay strong, right?
en: And if it's like that, it's important to stay strong, right?
ja: もしそうなら、強い心を持ち続けることが大事だよね?

key: CHILD: Huh...
en: CHILD: Huh...
ja: こども: へえ……

key: So that means I'm a hero?
en: So that means I'm a hero?
ja: じゃあ、ぼくはヒーローってこと?

key: SHELLY: You can be!
en: SHELLY: You can be!
ja: シェリー: なれるよ!

key: Um, I think, if you really try, you can be whatever you want!
en: Um, I think, if you really try, you can be whatever you want!
ja: えっと、本気でがんばれば、なりたいものになれると思う!

key: Or... Well, within reason... maybe?
en: Or... Well, within reason... maybe?
ja: あ……まあ、常識の範囲内で……たぶん?

key: CHILD: I kind of like that...
en: CHILD: I kind of like that...
ja: こども: それ、ちょっといいかも……

key: Okay, I want you two to have these for rescuing me!
en: Okay, I want you two to have these for rescuing me!
ja: よし、助けてくれたお礼に、これ二人にあげる!

key: I might have stolen them originally, but if I give them away, doesn't that make up for it?
en: I might have stolen them originally, but if I give them away, doesn't that make up for it?
ja: もともと盗んだものだけど、あげちゃえば帳消しになるよね?

key: CHILD: I'm definitely going to be a hero from now on!
en: CHILD: I'm definitely going to be a hero from now on!
ja: こども: これから絶対ヒーローになる!

key: CHARLOTTE: Hey, so, you gonna let me out, or are you just here to gawk?
en: CHARLOTTE: Hey, so, you gonna let me out, or are you just here to gawk?
ja: シャルロット: ちょっと、あたしを出す気あんの? それともただ見物に来ただけ?

key: CHARLOTTE: It's cool, it's not like I want you to let me go or anything.
en: CHARLOTTE: It's cool, it's not like I want you to let me go or anything.
ja: シャルロット: 別にいいけど。出してほしいとか思ってないし。

key: Just keep staring at me.
en: Just keep staring at me.
ja: そのままじーっと見てなさいよ。

key: Yeah. Like that.
en: Yeah. Like that.
ja: そう。そんな感じ。

key: Good work.
en: Good work.
ja: よくやった。

key: CHARLOTTE: You guys actually pulled through.
en: CHARLOTTE: You guys actually pulled through.
ja: シャルロット: あんたたち、本当にやり遂げたんだ。

key: CAIN: Of course we did~
en: CAIN: Of course we did~
ja: カイン: 当然でしょ~

key: You really doubted us?
en: You really doubted us?
ja: オレたちのこと、疑ってたわけ?

key: CHARLOTTE: You don't want me to answer that.
en: CHARLOTTE: You don't want me to answer that.
ja: シャルロット: それ、答えないほうがいいと思うけど。

key: CAIN: Hey, we're good!
en: CAIN: Hey, we're good!
ja: カイン: いや、オレたちすごいから!

key: ~ Me and my friends are gonna do it right, you'll never see us run away from a fight ~
en: ~ Me and my friends are gonna do it right, you'll never see us run away from a fight ~
ja: ~ オレと仲間はちゃんとやり遂げる、戦いから逃げるとこなんて見せないよ ~

key: CHARLOTTE: You're singing at a time like this?
en: CHARLOTTE: You're singing at a time like this?
ja: シャルロット: こんな時に歌ってんの?

key: CAIN: Yep!
en: CAIN: Yep!
ja: カイン: そうだよ!

key: CHARLOTTE: You're a regular magical princess, aren't you?
en: CHARLOTTE: You're a regular magical princess, aren't you?
ja: シャルロット: あんた、まるで魔法のプリンセスね。

key: CAIN: Someday my prince will come and sweep me away!
en: CAIN: Someday my prince will come and sweep me away!
ja: カイン: いつか王子様が迎えに来て、さらっていってくれるんだよねぇ!

key: Charlotte, dear, be my prince?!
en: Charlotte, dear, be my prince?!
ja: シャルロット、ねえ、オレの王子様になってよ?!

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, as if.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, as if.
ja: シャルロット: はいはい、ありえない。

key: ORDERLY: This guy is good...
en: ORDERLY: This guy is good...
ja: かんごにん: こいつ、やるな……

key: CAIN: You don't know the half of it, but even I have standards.
en: CAIN: You don't know the half of it, but even I have standards.
ja: カイン: まだ半分もわかってないと思うけど、オレにも一応こだわりはあるからね。

key: Get out of here!
en: Get out of here!
ja: とっとと出ていきな!

key: CAIN: Whew. Good job, Nidoking.
en: CAIN: Whew. Good job, Nidoking.
ja: カイン: ふう。よくやった、ニドキング。

key: Return~
en: Return~
ja: かえれ~

key: I'm just gonna take a little break now.
en: I'm just gonna take a little break now.
ja: オレ、ちょっと休憩するね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Well, that's all good and well, but I still need my cigarettes.
en: CHARLOTTE: Well, that's all good and well, but I still need my cigarettes.
ja: シャルロット: まあ、それはそれとして、あたしのタバコがまだ必要なんだけど。

key: CHARLOTTE: Their storage room is down that way.
en: CHARLOTTE: Their storage room is down that way.
ja: シャルロット: 保管室はあっちのほうにある。

key: We're gonna need to break in.
en: We're gonna need to break in.
ja: 押し入るしかないわね。

key: CAIN: For drugs? Real good influence you are on the kids here.
en: CAIN: For drugs? Real good influence you are on the kids here.
ja: カイン: ドラッグのため? ここの子供たちにとって、本当にいい影響だよねぇ。

key: CHARLOTTE: Don't sass me, princess.
en: CHARLOTTE: Don't sass me, princess.
ja: シャルロット: 生意気言わないで、プリンセス。

key: I was kidding about those.
en: I was kidding about those.
ja: あれは冗談。

key: Our Pokémon are being kept in there.
en: Our Pokémon are being kept in there.
ja: あたしたちのポケモンが、そこに保管されてるのよ。

key: SHELLY: Oh-oh, that's important!
en: SHELLY: Oh-oh, that's important!
ja: シェリー: あ、そ、それは大事だね!

key: Okay, we can do this, \PN!
en: Okay, we can do this, \PN!
ja: よし、やろう、\PN!

key: CHARLOTTE: They're keeping our Pokémon in storage down that way.
en: CHARLOTTE: They're keeping our Pokémon in storage down that way.
ja: シャルロット: あたしたちのポケモンは、あっちの保管室に置かれてるの。

key: SHELLY: We'll get them back for sure!
en: SHELLY: We'll get them back for sure!
ja: シェリー: 絶対取り返そう!

key: The girly-looking dude is surprisingly strong...
en: The girly-looking dude is surprisingly strong...
ja: あの女っぽい男、意外と強いな……

key: What's even going on...
en: What's even going on...
ja: 一体何が起きてるんだ……

key: This area is off limits to all unauthorized personnel!
en: This area is off limits to all unauthorized personnel!
ja: このエリアは、権限のない者は立ち入り禁止だ!

key: You're still not authorized.
en: You're still not authorized.
ja: それでも権限はないままよ。

key: Not that I can stop you.
en: Not that I can stop you.
ja: 別に止められるわけじゃないけど。

key: CHARLOTTE: All right, open the storage or I'll have \PN tear you to pieces.
en: CHARLOTTE: All right, open the storage or I'll have \PN tear you to pieces.
ja: シャルロット: いいから保管室を開けなさい、じゃないと\PNにズタズタにしてもらうわよ。

key: ORDERLY: Y-yes, okay...
en: ORDERLY: Y-yes, okay...
ja: かんごにん: は、はい、わかりました……

key: Four sets of Pokémon lined up--
en: Four sets of Pokémon lined up--
ja: ポケモンが四組並んでいる――

key: Charlotte, Anna, Noel, and--
en: Charlotte, Anna, Noel, and--
ja: シャルロット、アンナ、ノエル、それから――

key: Oh, Heather.
en: Oh, Heather.
ja: あ、ヘザーのも。

key: I'll just be taking these.
en: I'll just be taking these.
ja: これはもらっておく。

key: And that attractive looking pack of cigs.
en: And that attractive looking pack of cigs.
ja: それと、その色っぽいタバコの箱も。

key: Hello, sexy.
en: Hello, sexy.
ja: やあ、セクシー。

key: And finally...
en: And finally...
ja: それから、最後に……

key: One spare ID card. Check.
en: One spare ID card. Check.
ja: 予備のIDカードが一枚。よし。

key: All right, I'm good.
en: All right, I'm good.
ja: よし、これでオーケー。

key: Let's grab the girl and get out.
en: Let's grab the girl and get out.
ja: あの子を連れて、出よう。

key: I'll unlock the top level door and give the twins their stuff back.
en: I'll unlock the top level door and give the twins their stuff back.
ja: 最上階のドアを開けて、双子に荷物を返しておく。

key: Meet us upstairs when you're ready to party.
en: Meet us upstairs when you're ready to party.
ja: 準備ができたら、上で合流しよう。

key: ORDERLY: ...Y-yes, okay.
en: ORDERLY: ...Y-yes, okay.
ja: かんごにん: ……は、はい、わかりました。

key: CHARLOTTE: How gracious.
en: CHARLOTTE: How gracious.
ja: シャルロット: ずいぶん寛大なこと。

key: You're not getting those Pokémon back!
en: You're not getting those Pokémon back!
ja: そのポケモンは返してもらえないぞ!

key: Or maybe you are.
en: Or maybe you are.
ja: いや、返ってくるかもな。

key: Did the entire staff really just get overrun by the three of you?
en: Did the entire staff really just get overrun by the three of you?
ja: 職員が全員、まさかあんたたち三人にやられたっていうの?
